# Sparkle 2.10.0

Official SDK: https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/releases/tag/2.10.0

Archive: `Sparkle-2.10.0.tar.xz`

SHA-256: `c2bf58aa8387266ac179357b1415d6f2635f044da8be41042af32425dae6da0c`

`native/prepare_sparkle.sh` downloads and verifies the pinned archive on the first build.
The SDK stays in ignored `native/native-build/dependencies`; the framework is embedded
in the app with its upstream acknowledgements. The upstream license is included here
and in the application. No private update signing key is stored in the repository.
